::: {.hero}
# Time Series in Emergency Medicine
A two-day hands-on workshop · 21–22 October 2026
:::

## About the workshop

Emergency departments generate data every hour of every day. This workshop shows you how to explore, decompose, model and forecast that data using R.

## Objectives

At the end of the workshop, participants are able:

1. To understand concepts of time-series analysis and forecasting
2. To understand features and sources of time series data
3. To perform analysis of time series data using R
4. To appraise time-series and forecasting manuscripts
5. To understand concepts for GAM and joint-point regression

## Before you come

Please install the software on the [Prerequisites](prerequisites.qmd) page before Day 1. Slides, data and exercises are on the [Resources](resources.qmd) page.
